label: c/i/3/x input around the delimiter in long sequences (last original token or first copy step, t=7..11)
explanation: Fires only at absolute steps t=7..11 in long sequences (L>=7, ~62% of mass from L=9), never at t<=5, never on the delimiter step. Two positions dominate: the first copy step (recall_idx=1, input = orig(0) fed back; ~50% of mass) and the last original token (orig_idx=L-1; ~34%), plus a smaller tail at recall_idx=2 and orig_idx=L-2. Strongly gated by input token: c and i carry ~61% of mass (8x lift), then 3 and x; top activations are c or i input at the first copy step or final original position. Precision is limited because many c/i/3/x inputs at these positions do not fire (dependence on L/t and hidden state not captured) and other tokens (y, h, 0, r) fire weakly. Dev F1 ~0.50, mass recall ~0.66.
